payload.reason: The evidence provides various approaches to text analysis, including computational methods and qualitative analyses, highlighting their complementary nature.

claims.text: Text analysis approaches include statistical analysis focusing on style and computational analysis that identifies patterns in large datasets.
Combining large-scale computational analyses with small-scale qualitative analyses allows researchers to identify trends and tell individual stories.
The research process involves identifying questions, data selection, conceptualization, operationalization, and analysis, often overlapping and evolving throughout the project.
